title: The Late Bus to Class
story: Priya left home early, but the bus was not at the stop. A cold wind moved the trees, and a few students waited with their bags. Jonas looked at his watch and said the bus was already ten minutes late. Priya had a maths test in the first lesson, and she did not want to miss the start. She checked the paper timetable on the post. The bus should have come at half past seven. Jonas suggested they walk, but the school was too far for that. Priya kept her test notes in her hand so she could read them while she waited. At last the bus turned the corner. The driver opened the door and said there had been a broken traffic light in the town centre. Priya climbed on, showed her pass, and sat near the front. She used the ride to look over the first page of notes. When they reached the school gate, the bell was ringing. Priya thanked the driver and hurried across the yard with Jonas. They reached the classroom as the teacher was giving out the papers. Priya sat down, took a breath, and wrote her name. At lunch she told Jonas that waiting calmly had been better than starting a long walk. She also decided to leave home ten minutes earlier the next day, in case the bus was slow again.
